messages:
Rina CS: Flagging noise in renewal-risk for the June trial cohort — exported 200 rows, ~30% look like account variants (aliasing/SSO mismatch). s3://cs/exports/june_variants.csv
Sam Onboard: That's why we keep getting repeated onboarding reach-outs to the same org. Playbook trigger is too naive.
Alex Data: Quick cluster run suggests normalizing email (lowercase, strip + tags) and fallback to domain+org_name yields better grouping. Sample SQL:
```sql
select coalesce(sso_id, lower(regexp_replace(email,'\\+.*',''))) as canon, count(*) from accounts where created_at >= '2025-06-01' group by 1 order by 2 desc limit 50;
```
Alex Data: Proposal: computed `trial_family_hash` and change healthscore to count distinct families per org. Also add `duplicate_flag` and `duplicate_reason` for ops review.
Nora Ops: We can run a nightly non-blocking dedupe job to populate those fields and a small review view for CS to accept/reject. Exclude flagged rows from playbooks and renewal calculations.
Rina CS: Playbook tweak: replace `trial_count_org > 1` with `distinct_trial_families > 1` and add a 10-day cooldown after dedupe tagging so we don't re-fire.
Sam Onboard: I'll open CST ticket and a PR. Target: PR by tomorrow afternoon, feature-flagged rollout early next week. Assigning @Alex Data and @Nora Ops.
SchedBot: scheduled job `nightly-dedupe-20250725` for 2025-07-25T05:00:00Z :white_check_mark:
Alex Data: I'll add Grafana metric `cs.dup_family_rate` with a warn alert at 0.04 and backfill past 3 months.
Rina CS: Small UX ask: add an optional post-signup micro-survey for suspected duplicates: "Is someone else on your team already using Redwood?" yes/no + optional teammate email. Feed responses into the review UI.
Nora Ops: We'll wire survey into the pipeline and include the response in the CS ticket payload. Also add a note in the onboarding runbook about duplicate handling.
Sam Onboard: CST-478 created: "trial family dedupe + playbook cooldown" assigned to Sam, Alex, Nora. Will post PR link when ready. Thanks all :pray:
